legend-skyline-drive.slogan: Skyline Drive – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-skyline-drive.story: A park road from Front Royal, Virginia to Rockfish Gap, Virginia, via Thornton Gap. Key character: Shenandoah ridgeline; wildlife; overlooks. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Skyline Drive
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 20 km this is Skyline Drive, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

hopkinton-and-the-westborough-lanes.title: Hopkinton and the Westborough Lanes
hopkinton-and-the-westborough-lanes.slogan: The country west of the marathon start: reservoirs, orchards and lanes that were never straightened for commuters.

hopkinton-and-the-westborough-lanes.provenance: MANUAL SEED: every stop was entered by hand from a known position on the road. The distance is the seed figure, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces it. Altitudes are present only where they were known; the rest are null rather than zero.

scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 16 km this is Blackstone Valley Byway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

hopkinton-and-the-westborough-lanes.story: 44 km from Hopkinton to Southborough, about 51 min of riding. It goes by way of Westborough and Northborough. The line favours views over speed.
